name: Spriglet: Desktop Companion
subtitle: A little quiet company
description:
Meet Sprout, a soft, leaf-eared companion for your Mac. Pet it, watch it settle, or share a short game with a firefly. Spriglet lives in your menu bar and brings a little quiet company to your desktop.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose a name, three sizes, and a Quiet, Balanced, or Lively activity level. Keep your companion parked or allow occasional short strolls that return home.

SMALL MOMENTS, SIMPLE CONTROLS
Click to pet, drag to move, or play with a firefly. Pause, hide, and pass clicks through whenever you need. Optional interaction sounds and launch at login start off.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, analytics, or server connection. Preferences stay on your Mac. Spriglet does not capture your screen, monitor global keystrokes, or read other apps.

MADE FOR MAC
Native Settings, app-scoped keyboard commands, and support for Reduce Motion. Find Spriglet in the leaf menu in your menu bar; it has no Dock icon.

Requires an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or later.
promotionalText: A soft, leaf-eared desktop companion. Pet, play, or enjoy a quiet moment together. Local preferences, optional sounds, and simple controls.
reviewNotes:
Spriglet is a free, local desktop companion for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later. No account, sign-in, purchases, subscription, backend, or special permissions are required.

On first launch, a Quick Guide appears. The app uses a leaf menu in the menu bar and intentionally has no Dock icon. Click Get Started to open Settings. The pet appears in a transparent floating window.

Click the pet to see its reaction; drag to reposition. In the leaf menu, choose Play with Firefly. Parked Mode is on by default; turn it off to permit short automatic strolls. Pause, Hide Pet, Pass Clicks Through, and Quit remain available from the leaf menu. Settings > Desktop provides placement controls. Transparent window margins may intercept clicks; Pass Clicks Through sends clicks through the whole pet window. The pet may appear over full-screen apps; Hide Pet is available when needed.

Settings > General contains optional sounds, opt-in Launch at Login, the Quick Guide, Privacy Policy, support, and license. Login registration changes only after the user chooses it; macOS may require approval in Login Items. Reduce Motion keeps the pet still.

An optional Developer Diagnostics window is accessible with the --diagnostics launch argument. It runs finite, user-requested local performance checks. This mode suppresses saved-choice changes, sound, and login registration. Copy Report only copies after a deliberate click. It unlocks no paid content or alternative functionality. Please assess the ordinary launch for the customer experience.
